notes: Corrected: the source head of the fused lenegd unit moves from s018 to s019. Rule 23 heads a fusion on the morpheme carrying content the others lack, and its compound-preposition carve-out is limited to pairs where none does; negd carries the 'over against' relation that lamed does not, exactly as lifne → 'before' heads on pane. Rule 24 then makes 'against' the target head, whereas under the old source head no English token realized the head's lexeme at all. Only that field changed; edges, target head and every other unit stand.

'Art' goes to the interrogative particle, which is what the ASV's fronted copula answers to in a verbless question (rules 17, 20), leaving attah only its 'thou' and the predicate lamed only its 'for'.
'there stood' keeps the presentative dummy with the participle's unit under rule 17, since 'a man' is the clause's own subject noun and takes only its own English.
